seoTitle: Git Diff Viewer: Unified Diff and Patch Side by Side
metaDescription: Paste git diff or patch output and read each file as two columns with added and removed lines marked. Free, runs locally, nothing uploaded.
intro: Renders unified diffs and .patch files as side-by-side columns or a single unified view, with line numbers and an added and removed count.
why:
Raw diff text is hard to read once a change touches many lines. A side-by-side view shows the old and new line next to each other so you can review quickly, for example a patch someone sent by email.

The parser reads git diff, git show and plain unified diffs. It pairs removed and added lines inside a hunk. It does not recompute the diff, so what you see is exactly what the patch says. Word-level highlights are not drawn; use the two-text diff tools for that.
howTo: Paste the output of git diff, git show or a .patch file.
Choose side by side or unified layout.
Scroll through the files and hunks.
Check the status line for the number of added and removed lines.

faq.a: Unified diffs as made by git diff, git show, git format-patch and diff -u. Context diffs and binary patches are not supported.
